name: tts-s22
description: On-device text-to-speech for the S22: the owner's own voice for Greek and English (engine antonis: the rig's VoxCPM voice, Piper el-antonis on the phone as the offline fallback; other s22-say engines only with allow_engine_override) rendered through s22-touchd and, by default, spoken through the phone speaker (firmware-graph audio path; the amps return to the resting mute afterwards). Set play=false to render only.
